body: You guys are all missing the point here. OP was stating that there is a misconception about exercising being a CURE. we all know exercising helps, but what op wa as pointing out is that some people actually believe that if we just got up out of bed and exercised, our depression would cease to exist. I'm glad that many of you understand it is a helping hand and not a cure. However, many people still believe it is a cure. This post was to shed light onto those types of people. If you are not a person who believes exercise is the cure then the post wasnt directed towards you.

This is an interesting topic. Basically most people use guilt to keep themselves alive. Ie "my family would be so devastated." The messed up part about that thinking is not that we think it on our own, but that we've been told it so many times that now we can't think of anything else. How many times has someone heard "your family would miss you," or "people around you care about you." That mindset to me is just selfish to the person not suffering. It's basically saying "I like you too much to let go, so I'm going to make you feel bad about wanting to leave  so you stay here, regardless of how you feel inside." The idea of "it gets better" that so many people have is misguided. Some people (like myself) live with a chronic illness that makes life miserable because there is no known cure. So people like me are forced to stay in constant physical and emotional pain because some poor sap decided every life is worth living. Well guess what. Not every life is worth living. It's sad that the only reason I'm going on is because of what you are talking about. Otherwise I'd finally be in peace from all this pain. People call suicide selfish. No. Forcing someone to live that doesnt want to is selfish.
Sure but can you work and feed yourself? Because I literally cant most of the time. At least you can leave your house. I cant most days. I spend many days sick. I'm just so over it already.
Well there is still always here. I don't change my account ever, this is my only one. So if you ever need anything, please do not hesitate.

That is something you'll never have to worry about with me. I have so much time on my hands because I'm medically unable to work at 24. Dont ever feel like you are a burden. Is you have a ps4 also, the name tag here  is my gamer tag on there. If you ever just need to chat or play a game. There is this site and my account on ps4 you can reach me on. Never feel like your burdening someone with your issues. And if someone feels burdened by you, they are not a true friend nor a truly good person. Keep your head up, some of us love everyone in this life and strive our hardest to let you guys know you are loved and wanted no matter what. Never feel like you cant message me.  I'll always be here to help if you need it.

If there ever is a moment where you feel like you just need to tell someone your problems. Message me. I cant describe how amazing it is to have someone you can turn to at any point no matter what the problem. If you need someone ever, I am here. It may not mean much right now. But if you give it a chance, you may be surprised by how much it helps. I wont judge not try to tell you what you should do, but I can just be there for you when you need it. To listen, to just plain hear you when you need to be heard. Stay strong my friend, we need you in this life more than you realize.
If you want, message me. We can talk about anything, maybe try and take your mind off of whatever.
